title: A key input disappears
body: The main component, ingredient or supplier your product depends on is unavailable for the next 18 months. Existing stock lasts six weeks.

title: A new rule bans how you operate
body: A new government or college rule bans the way your company currently delivers its product or service, starting next month.

title: A legal complaint stops sales
body: A complaint about copyright, a patent or a contract forces your product to be taken down until the dispute is settled.

title: Your biggest partner walks away
body: The partner that brings you most of your customers ends the relationship and will start a competing service.

title: Customer data is leaked
body: Customer data is leaked online. Customers are angry, and the press is asking what you will do.

title: The money dries up
body: Banks and investors stop lending to young companies. The payment you expected next month will not come.

title: A giant copies you
body: A large, well-funded company launches the same product at half your price, with a big marketing campaign.

title: Your product hurts someone
body: A customer is hurt using your product. You must stop sales until it is proven safe.

title: Customers stop paying
body: Your main customer group suddenly has much less money, and most say they will cancel or stop buying.

title: A disaster shuts you down
body: A flood damages your premises and equipment. You cannot operate for at least two months.
